entries.title: ⌘1 always picks a card's recommended choice
entries.body: On every card, ⌘1 now presses the recommended button, so the same key always takes the suggested step. The other buttons count up from right to left: ⌘2 is the next button to the left, then ⌘3 and ⌘4. On Linux, Ctrl takes ⌘'s place.

picture.alt: A decision card whose Approve and build button shows ⌘1 at the right edge, with Save and defer ⌘2 and Abandon ⌘3 to its left
